# OrbINT

OrbINT is a local desk for open-source reconnaissance, operated by Delexoo. Cases stay in the browser. There is no account.

## Pages

- [Desk](https://orbint.net/): the app. The operator guide opens inside it.
- [Privacy](https://orbint.net/privacy.html): what stays on the device and what a lookup sends out.
- [Terms](https://orbint.net/terms.html): rules of use.
- [Contact](https://orbint.net/contact.html): Delexoo, at https://github.com/Delexoo.
